acceptanceCriteria.text: Reuse P1.4 Windows lexical normalization, preserve case, and reject distinct old keys converging before any database mutation.
Apply requires successful verified backup; all database changes and FK validation occur in one transaction; repeat apply is a no-op.
Dry-run inventory and planning run only on a database copy; report mappings, table and workspace counts, and retained manual triage hashes without secrets.
HTTP and STDIO startup refuse legacy Windows workspace ids and point to --workspace-path-rekey.
Recompute only derivable triage, handoff, and federation identities; repoint children; preserve manual triage hashes and rewrite token-store keys with file backup.

result.description: WorkspaceIdentityPath.NormalizeLexicalPath emits '/' for Windows paths (UNC keeps leading '//'; \\?\ device prefixes stripped to drive or // form); BuildStorageKey becomes windows:C:/WORKSPACES/EXAMPLE style. IsRemoteWindowsPath, IsNormalizedPathWithinRoot and NormalizeLocalAdministrativeShareAlias accept both separators. A ToNativePath helper produces backslash paths only for Win32 CreateFile/GetFinalPathNameByHandle, \\?\ long-path prefixes and cmd.exe arguments. Persisted data is rewritten by an explicit maintenance command --workspace-path-rekey (decision D5, 2026-10-07) modelled on McpDatabaseEncryptionTransitionCommand: required backup unless --dry-run, report with old->new mapping and before/after counts; one transaction per database with foreign keys deferred or suspended and fully re-validated (decision D6: SQLite defer_foreign_keys, SQL Server NOCHECK then WITH CHECK CHECK, PostgreSQL DEFERRABLE + SET CONSTRAINTS ALL DEFERRED); set-based UPDATE per workspace column from a mapping table limited to Windows-shaped values; C# recomputation of hashed values (federation GlobalWorkspaceId/CanonicalWorkspaceId and hub hash-keyed Workspaces rows, TriageGroups GroupKey/GroupId with repointed children, HandoffIngestionRuns ReplayIdentity); FileGitHubWorkspaceTokenStore keys rewritten. No legacy dual-key lookup (decision D7): a startup guard refuses to start while any Windows-shaped workspace id still contains a backslash. Enrolled proxies are re-enrolled once after deploy (the Windows proxy in the original deployment). Plan: docs/plans/2026-10-07-federation-fixes.md section 4c.
result.notes: P1.5 operator decisions 2026-10-16: Policy A uses existing Windows lexical normalizer including device-prefix stripping and case preservation. Distinct old keys converging abort before mutation. Manual triage keys are SHA-256(workspacePath|manual|random GUID); retain their GroupKey/GroupId because GUID is not stored. Only recompute derived identities verified from persisted inputs. Worktree-only implementation and disposable fixture/copy tests; no live apply, service operations, deploy, or merge. Current task explicitly requests requirements/tests first (red), then implementation.
result.title: Forward-slash storage keys, rekey maintenance command and startup guard
